name: Stage 27: Knorranvägen to Strångsjövägen
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 27, Knorranvägen to Strångsjövägen.
utilities: Stage 27 is an official 15.5 km Knorranvägen-Strångsjövägen stage. It is mostly easy forest/track walking with road crossings, Skirtorpssjön reserve landscape, Forssjö bruk context and some wetter/working-forest sections.
Skogen, also tied to Ramsjöhultslingan, is the main overnight/rest node with shelter, fireplace, dry toilet shortly after the shelter and nearby spring.

Forssjö/Bruksholmen is the main service area: restaurant/event food, unmanned 24Food/shop context and water refill are reported by the stage maintainer, but Bruksholmen low-season opening is event-calendar dependent and day-of access should be checked.

Access is practical by car at Knorranvägen, road 52/Forssjö area and Strångsjövägen. Public transport exists nearby, but not as clean point-to-point transit; verify named stops such as Glysas grav, Rökstorp, Forssjö bruk and Spökbacken with Sörmlandstrafiken live planning.
waterSources: Official springs are listed near Skogen and at Skirtorpsmossen/Mo Källa. Treat/filter/boil both: Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee quality or flow.

The Skirtorpsmossen/Mo Källa source is better triangulated by OSM drinking-water data near the official coordinate, but a late-summer hiker report described it as barely dripping. The Skogen spring is official but less independently mapped. Carry backup.
Bruksholmen/Forssjö is a reported refill/service option when open or accessible, but it is maintainer-reported and business-dependent; it should not replace carrying enough water for the full stage.
Do not add the OSM-only drinking-water point near/after Strångsjövägen as reliable until independently confirmed.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official/Naturkartan distance is 15.5 km. OSM relation 3925149 is tagged 16 km and summed geometry is about 15.37 km, while local generated geometry is about 15.1 km and AllTrails about 15.3 km; use official 15.5 km as canonical.

Draw Stage 27 as the continuous Knorranvägen-Strångsjövägen mainline, including the shared Ramsjöhultsslingan segment to Skogen. Keep Stage 27:1/Stora Djulö connector, Katrineholmsetappen, Ramsjöhultsslingan loop beyond the shared segment, Rundslinga Forssjö/Stage 28:1, Ceres bicycle overlaps and facility/service spurs separate.

Official difficulty is lättgången/easy, but the stage is long enough to feel moderate for a day hike. Expect forest paths, gravel/road sections, working forest, reserve terrain, and older/mid-aged user reports of muddy, rutted or wet passages after rain.

Official page showed no current formal fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Official comments reported the road-55/56 underpass water-filled in 2024 and April 2025; planks were reported installed on 2025-05-27. Keep it as a possible wet-footing risk, not a current confirmed closure.

A 2025-05-30 official comment reported many wasp nests starting at Skogen shelter, but the latest research pass did not find independent corroboration. Treat as seasonal/inspect-on-arrival rather than a standing defect.

Skirtorpssjön reserve rules verified online include not damaging esker formations by extracting stone, gravel, sand or soil. Länsstyrelsen also warns bark-beetle-damaged spruces may fall. Do not invent additional reserve-specific camping/fire bans; posted signs and general fire restrictions still apply.
Suitable tent places are officially named at Skirtorp and Trollholmen/Forssjö. Present them as trail-maintainer-suitable spots, not serviced campsites.

No bin or waste facility was verified on Stage 27 itself; carry out waste. VSR/Katrineholm showed no formal fire ban during the 2026-04-27 pass, but VSR and Länsstyrelsen/SMHI signalled dry/high fire-risk conditions, so use only prepared fireplaces where present and prefer skipping open fire unless day-of conditions clearly allow it.

facilities.name: Knorranvägen stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start with small parking; official text says about five cars. OSM route geometry is very close but not identical.

facilities.name: Road 55/56 underpass wet-footing warning
facilities.description: Road 55/56 underpass near the start. Official comments reported water-filled passage on 2024-03-18 and again on 2025-04-13; planks were reported installed on 2025-05-27. Keep as possible wet-footing risk, not a current confirmed closure, and do not cross the road at grade because of fencing/traffic.

facilities.name: Skogen shelter / Ramsjöhultslingan
facilities.description: Official shelter and main early overnight/rest node, independently matched by Naturkartan, OSM and Vindskyddskartan. Free, shared, first-come and non-bookable.

facilities.name: Skogen fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at the Skogen shelter. No firewood guarantee; use only when fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Skogen dry toilet
facilities.description: Official stage text says a dry toilet is shortly after the Skogen shelter; exact separate toilet coordinate is not published in checked official/Naturkartan text, so this shelter-cluster pin should be field-verified.

facilities.name: Skogen shelter wasp caveat
facilities.description: A 2025-05-30 official comment reported multiple wasp nests starting at the shelter. Seasonal and not a closure; check before settling in.

facilities.name: Spring near Skogen
facilities.description: Official cold spring shortly after/near Skogen. Independent map confirmation is limited; treat/filter and verify flow.

facilities.name: Glysas grav bus and heritage context
facilities.description: Nearby bus/access and cultural-history context for Sörmland's largest ship setting. Useful for Skirtorpssjön access; verify current bus departures.

facilities.name: Road 52 crossing and stage 27:1 link
facilities.description: Road 52 / road 55-56 roundabout-area crossing and current Stage 27:1 join. Official Stage 27 says the connector to STF Stora Djulö is 4 km from here; Stage 27:1 now turns south at the roundabout and Glysas grav is not the canonical endpoint. Cross with traffic care.

facilities.name: Rökstorp / Forssjö friluftsområde parking
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen-listed reserve access parking with capacity for more than 10 cars/bus near Rökstorp/Forssjö friluftsområde. Useful mid-stage access but not a resupply point.

facilities.name: Skirtorpssjön reserve warning
facilities.description: Reserve landscape with eskers/kettle holes. Do not damage esker formations by extracting stone, gravel, sand or soil. Länsstyrelsen warns bark-beetle-damaged spruce may fall; service info lists information board, rest area and hiking trail only.

facilities.name: Jättens handfat / Skirtorpssjön rest
facilities.description: Good official rest/highlight area around Jättens handfat / Skirtorpssjön kettle-hole landscape. Steep kettle-hole banks and sensitive esker landforms nearby; do not claim a fireplace here unless field-verified.

facilities.name: Skirtorp suitable tent context
facilities.description: Officially named suitable tent area around Skirtorp/Skirtorpssjön. Not a serviced campsite; use low-impact camping, keep clear of paths/water/steep banks, and follow local signs.

facilities.name: Skirtorpsmossen / Mo Källa
facilities.description: Official natural water point; OSM has a nearby drinking-water tag, but Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee quality or availability. Treat/filter and carry backup; a late-summer hiker report described very low flow.

facilities.name: Forssjö badplats and rest
facilities.description: Official good rest/bathing/canoe context near Forssjö/Forssjösjön. Havs- och vattenmyndigheten listed 2025 samples as tjänligt and 2026-season classification as excellent, but check current bathing status; fishing likely requires a permit.

facilities.name: Trollholmen / Forssjö suitable tent context
facilities.description: Officially named suitable tent area around Trollholmen/Forssjö. Treat as an informal suitable spot, not a serviced campsite; use durable ground away from homes, paths and water.

facilities.name: Bruksholmen Forssjö services
facilities.description: Restaurant/event food, stage-maintainer-reported 24Food unmanned shop and water refill around Bruksvägen 17. Bruksholmen confirms restaurant/event/catering, a small food shop and low-season event-calendar opening; a 2023 bankruptcy report is superseded by current web presence but day-of food/shop/refill availability must be verified.

facilities.name: Forssjö bruk transit context
facilities.description: Named Forssjö bruk bus-stop context near services and stage line. Verify route and times with Sörmlandstrafiken; service patterns changed in late 2025.

facilities.name: Rökstorp reserve bus context
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen lists Rökstorp as a bus stop for Skirtorpssjön/Forssjö friluftsområde access. Verify current departures.

facilities.name: Spökbacken bus context
facilities.description: Named rural bus-stop context for the southern part of the stage, still not directly at the Strångsjövägen endpoint. Verify live routing and expect road walking.

facilities.name: Strångsjövägen stage end
facilities.description: Stage end and stage-28 start context. Parking is possible but limited; stage 28 text says 2-3 cars at the end points.

facilities.name: No verified Stage 27 bins
facilities.description: No bin or waste facility was verified on Stage 27 itself. Do not rely on bins at Skogen, Skirtorpssjön, Forssjö or Strångsjövägen; carry out waste.
